description: Runs puppet agent or apply in a reliable manner.

parameters.name: certname
parameters.description: The name to use when handling certificates.

parameters.name: confdir
parameters.description: Path to the directory containing the puppet.conf file.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Enable full debugging. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Puppet environment to be used.

parameters.name: environment_lang
parameters.description: The lang environment to use when running the puppet agent. The default value, C, is supported on every system, but can lead to encoding errors if UTF-8 is used in the output. Use C.UTF-8 or en_US.UTF-8 or similar UTF-8 supporting locales in case of problems. You need to make sure the selected locale is supported on the system the puppet agent runs on. Starting with community.general 9.1.0, you can use the value auto and the module tries to determine the best parseable locale to use. Default: "C"

parameters.name: execute
parameters.description: Execute a specific piece of Puppet code. It has no effect with a puppetmaster.

parameters.name: facter_basename
parameters.description: Basename of the facter output file. Default: "ansible"

parameters.name: facts
parameters.description: A dict of values to pass in as persistent external facter facts.

parameters.name: logdest
parameters.description: Where the puppet logs should go, if puppet apply is being used. all goes to both console and syslog. stdout is deprecated and replaced by console. Choices: "all" "stdout" ← (default) "syslog"

parameters.name: manifest
parameters.description: Path to the manifest file to run puppet apply on.

parameters.name: modulepath
parameters.description: Path to an alternate location for puppet modules.

parameters.name: noop
parameters.description: Override puppet.conf noop mode. When true, run Puppet agent with --noop switch set. When false, run Puppet agent with --no-noop switch set. When unset (default), use default or puppet.conf value if defined. Choices: false true

parameters.name: puppetmaster
parameters.description: The hostname of the puppetmaster to contact.

parameters.name: show_diff
parameters.description: Whether to print file changes details. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skip_tags
parameters.description: A list of puppet tags to be excluded.

parameters.name: summarize
parameters.description: Whether to print a transaction summary. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A list of puppet tags to be used.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for puppet to finish. This parameter is deprecated and will be removed in community.general 14.0.0. Use the task-level timeout keyword instead. To suppress this deprecation warning, set timeout to "". Default: "30m"

parameters.name: use_srv_records
parameters.description: Toggles use_srv_records flag. Choices: false true

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Print extra information. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: waitforlock
parameters.description: The maximum amount of time puppet should wait for an already running puppet agent to finish before starting. If a number without unit is provided, it is assumed to be a number of seconds. Allowed units are m for minutes and h for hours.

examples:
- name: Run puppet agent and fail if anything goes wrong
  community.general.puppet:

- name: Run puppet and timeout in 5 minutes
  community.general.puppet:
    timeout: 5m

- name: Run puppet using a different environment
  community.general.puppet:
    environment: testing

- name: Run puppet using a specific certname
  community.general.puppet:
    certname: agent01.example.com

- name: Run puppet using a specific piece of Puppet code. Has no effect with a puppetmaster
  community.general.puppet:
    execute: include ::mymodule

- name: Run puppet using a specific tags
  community.general.puppet:
    tags:
      - update
      - nginx
    skip_tags:
      - service

- name: Wait 30 seconds for any current puppet runs to finish
  community.general.puppet:
    waitforlock: 30

- name: Wait 5 minutes for any current puppet runs to finish
  community.general.puppet:
    waitforlock: 5m

- name: Run puppet agent in noop mode
  community.general.puppet:
    noop: true

- name: Run a manifest with debug, log to both syslog and console, specify module path
  community.general.puppet:
    modulepath: /etc/puppet/modules:/opt/stack/puppet-modules:/usr/share/openstack-puppet/modules
    logdest: all
    manifest: /var/lib/example/puppet_step_config.pp
